name: Noachian-Cwm
description: A shell of ancient ice seals the world, cracked into plates the size of nations and refrozen in place. Pressure ridges stack in turquoise ramparts, gleaming under a stingy sun near a nearby asteroid belt.
Thin air makes every breath a small transaction. Locals, when there are locals, move slowly and speak quietly, conserving everything.
Instruments disagree about the spatial rift remnant: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
Whoever solves this anomaly will rewrite several sciences. Whoever blunders into it will merely end several careers.
